doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Singers worked with and tonight's set
summary: He has appeared with B.B. King, Bobby Bland, Albert King, Joe Williams, and plays tonight with McShann and Fiddler Williams.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: What kind of occasions have you had to be on stage with other singers, some of the other singers you’ve worked with.
B.B. King, Bobby Blue Bland, Albert King. I just heard a record the other day by Freddie King, the late Freddie King. I didn’t even know he cut “Ain’t Nobody’s Business.”
Have you ever sung with Joe Williams on the same stage?
You look forward to seeing Joe?
I certainly will. And tonight you do a set with Jay and —
Yeah. I don’t even know who’s going to be on.
Well we’ll find out. I guess that’s the beauty of this music is as long as you have capable musicians you can get together and—
